_comment: The store build members actually have installed. Updated by hand when a new build goes live on Google Play (Production track, 'Released on' time). scripts/publish-update.mjs refuses a public over-the-air update when the native surface (package.json dependencies, app.json plugins/permissions) differs between android.commit and the code being published — see scripts/native-surface-lib.cjs. verify:release checks the version code being built is not below this one.
